description: This file defines the 'FeaturePropertiesCreated' event class in Java, representing an event emitted after a Feature's properties are created within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, accessing properties, and serialization logic. It also references various Json and Ditto model classes, as well as Metadata and Headers.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesCreated
classes.description: An immutable class representing the event emitted after a Feature's properties are created. It contains fields for feature ID and properties, methods for constructing instances from JSON or parameters, and serialization logic.
